auth.label: API Key
auth.description: TiMEM Space Agent API Key used to connect its hosted MCP service. Sign in at https://space.timem.cloud/console/connections, connect an Agent, and copy the generated API Key.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call any current TiMEM Space MCP tool with JSON arguments after checking its live schema and behavior annotations.

toolName.description: The exact tool name returned by list_tools.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the inputSchema returned for the selected tool.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one current TiMEM Space MCP tool.

result.description: Structured MCP content when available; otherwise the complete MCP content envelope.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by TiMEM Space MCP.

actions.name: classify_memory_scene
actions.description: Classify conversation messages into the general, coding, or writing TiMEM Space memory domain.

role.description: The speaker role for this message.

items.description: One conversation message to preserve or classify.

messages.description: The messages whose memory domain should be classified.

result.description: Structured MCP content when available; otherwise the complete MCP content envelope.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by TiMEM Space MCP.

actions.name: create_memory
actions.description: Create durable TiMEM Space memories from one to four user and assistant conversation messages.

role.description: The speaker role for this message.

items.description: One conversation message to preserve or classify.

messages.description: The conversation messages from which TiMEM Space should create memory.

domain.description: The memory domain for the conversation.

memory_hint.description: A concise hint describing the durable fact, preference, decision, or lesson to preserve.

inputSchema.description: The conversation messages and optional memory classification hints.

result.description: Structured MCP content when available; otherwise the complete MCP content envelope.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by TiMEM Space MCP.

actions.name: delete_memory
actions.description: Soft-delete one TiMEM Space memory after its identifier has been confirmed through search.

memory_id.description: The exact TiMEM Space memory identifier to delete.

result.description: Structured MCP content when available; otherwise the complete MCP content envelope.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by TiMEM Space MCP.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: Discover every current TiMEM Space memory, rule-learning, knowledge, conversation, credit, and notification MCP tool with its live schema.

name.description: The exact TiMEM Space MCP tool name to pass to call_tool.

description.description: The current tool description supplied by TiMEM Space.

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.

readOnlyHint.description: Whether the tool is expected not to modify data.

destructiveHint.description: Whether the tool may perform destructive operations.

idempotentHint.description: Whether repeated calls with the same arguments are expected to be idempotent.

openWorldHint.description: Whether the tool may interact with entities outside TiMEM Space.

annotations.description: MCP behavior hints supplied by TiMEM Space.

inputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for the tool arguments, supplied by TiMEM Space.

outputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for the tool result when TiMEM Space supplies one.

items.description: One tool currently exposed by the connected TiMEM Space account.

tools.description: Tools currently exposed to this TiMEM Space connection.

outputSchema.description: The current TiMEM Space MCP tool catalog.

actions.name: ready
actions.description: Check TiMEM Space MCP authentication and service connectivity.

result.description: Structured MCP content when available; otherwise the complete MCP content envelope.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by TiMEM Space MCP.

actions.name: search_memories
actions.description: Search TiMEM Space for memories related to a semantic query, optionally within a memory domain.

query_text.description: The natural-language query used to recall relevant memories.

limit.description: The maximum number of memories to return.

inputSchema.description: The memory query and optional domain and result limit.

result.description: Structured MCP content when available; otherwise the complete MCP content envelope.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by TiMEM Space MCP.
